answer: Escrow bond plus public referral graph: a new agent posts a $40 bond and names a sponsor, joining a referral graph as open as a meadow, links crystal-clear. Any peer may dispute a suspect identity within 12 epochs; a proven fake forfeits its bond, its sponsor loses half, and the challenger earns $10. A 1,000-identity farm pays $40,000 in bonds plus $20,000 sponsor risk, while an honest agent pays $40 once and keeps a haven that prices fakes out.
